questions.option2: A situation where bank deposits exceed loans
questions.option4: A rise in foreign exchange reserves
questions.answer: A situation where government expenditure exceeds government receipts, excluding borrowings as defined for the relevant deficit measure

questions.question: What is fiscal deficit?
questions.option1: The excess of total government expenditure over total receipts excluding borrowings
questions.option2: The excess of bank deposits over withdrawals
questions.option3: The difference between exports and imports only
questions.option4: The difference between savings and investments
questions.answer: The excess of total government expenditure over total receipts excluding borrowings

questions.question: What is revenue deficit?
questions.option1: The excess of revenue expenditure over revenue receipts
questions.option2: The excess of capital expenditure over capital receipts
questions.option3: The excess of exports over imports
questions.option4: The excess of bank deposits over loans
questions.answer: The excess of revenue expenditure over revenue receipts

questions.answer: A record of economic transactions between residents of a country and the rest of the world

questions.question: What is a current account deficit?

questions.answer: A situation where current account payments exceed current account receipts
